title: It’s free
body:
No in app purchase, no catch. Does the job well, not just for streaks but for counts too (incase you workout 5 days a week, then there’s no pressure in getting a workout streak going).

Now if only it has a monochromatic mode to match with my dump phone setup
author: Almisc15

title: Perfectly good
body:
I’m not sure if this is a bug or something but is it really as this good and free with not a single ad at all.

Thank you so much it’s so simple and easy to understand with settings and options to help me track my habits, but I have a single issue why does the habit still show up if it’s not supposed to be done today, all habits show up whatever it’s date is

author: anHonestRewer

title: I love this app.
body: This app is just to good to be true, a diamond in the rough. It's exactly like I wanted with widgets and "strikes" for everytime you fill out your habit. It's great.
author: haelena0109

title: Holy it actually Is completely free
body: I was used to an app being “free” and asking for extreme amounts of money so I created a few quick habits expecting to see that pop up after 5 habits but it never did. I wasn’t sure if there was a catch because it looked too good to be true but when I saw that it didn’t say in app purchases on the Apple Store page I got convinced lol. It’s really nice and simple. Only catch could be it not being optimized for iPads (it doesn’t fully fill the screen) but it’s something you can ignore in portrait mode. Overall, great app!
